component.name: Explorer
component.summary: Open, edit and share almost any file

description.p: Explorer is a file manager that opens over 300 file types inside the app: documents, e-books, comics, archives, photos, video, music, 3D models and code.
It can annotate PDFs and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, send files to nearby devices with LocalSend, share a folder with a browser or FTP app over Wi-Fi, and download videos with yt-dlp.
